mapper.sql: c.ranking_id, c.ranking_code, c.ranking_name, c.ranking_type, c.period_type, c.top_n, c.weight_config, c.is_active, c.updated_at, (SELECT MAX(i.period_no) FROM ranking_item i WHERE i.ranking_id = c.ranking_id) AS latest_period_no, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ranking_item i2 WHERE i2.ranking_id = c.ranking_id AND i2.period_no = ( SELECT MAX(i3.period_no) FROM ranking_item i3 WHERE i3.ranking_id = c.ranking_id ) ), 0) AS latest_item_count
